harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves a persistent local RPM repository over HTTP and successfully installed tree from it while all usual CentOS repositories were unreachable. Repository service, content, and package survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created /srv/repos/local containing the signed tree RPM and generated repository metadata.
Configured local-node1 with GPG checking and HTTP base URL http://10.100.41.10:8080/.
Enabled a hardened systemd service to serve the repository on port 8080.
Forced BaseOS, AppStream, and Extras through a verified dead endpoint during installation; DNF ignored them and installed tree from local-node1.
Restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Shows valid signed RPM content and repodata, enabled/active HTTP service, port 8080 listener, HTTP 200 metadata retrieval, byte-for-byte metadata match, and DNF visibility through local-node1.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: Shows BaseOS, AppStream, and Extras failing through the verified dead proxy, DNF selecting tree from local-node1, successful installation, executable output, and transaction provenance @local-node1.

Baseline boot ID was ebf808c5-68cd-4bb5-9787-d13d77dbb1c3 with healthy service, HTTP metadata, repository files, and package. Restart was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 2338d20d-79d8-4581-94ab-a9be3f127a3b. Post-restart proof shows system running, service enabled/active, HTTP 200, matching metadata, valid signed RPM, local DNF visibility, and operational tree package.
